templates.name: General Information Request
templates.subject: RTI Application - Request for Information
templates.body:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
[Department Name]

Subject: Application under Right to Information Act, 2005

Sir/Madam,

I would like to request the following information under the Right to Information Act, 2005:

[YOUR REQUEST HERE]

I am willing to pay the applicable fees as prescribed under the RTI Act.

Please provide the information at the earliest.

Thanking you,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
[YOUR PHONE NUMBER]

templates.name: Government Spending Details
templates.subject: RTI Application - Request for Expenditure Details
templates.body:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
[Department Name]

Subject: Application under Right to Information Act, 2005 - Expenditure Details

Sir/Madam,

I would like to request the following information under the Right to Information Act, 2005:

1. Total budget allocated for [SCHEME/PROJECT NAME] for FY [YEAR]
2. Actual expenditure incurred
3. Breakdown of expenses by category
4. List of beneficiaries (if applicable)
5. Any pending utilization certificates

I am willing to pay the applicable fees as prescribed under the RTI Act.

Thanking you,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
[YOUR PHONE NUMBER]

templates.name: MP/MLA Related Information
templates.subject: RTI Application - Elected Representative Details
templates.body:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
[Legislative Assembly/Parliament]

Subject: Application under Right to Information Act, 2005 - Elected Representative Information

Sir/Madam,

I would like to request the following information under the Right to Information Act, 2005:

1. Attendance record of [MP/MLA NAME] in [House] sessions for [PERIOD]
2. Questions raised and debates participated
3. MPLAD/MLALAD fund utilization details
4. Any pending asset declarations

I am willing to pay the applicable fees as prescribed under the RTI Act.

Thanking you,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
[YOUR PHONE NUMBER]
